entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-22
entry.content:
Issues

  • Static files and file results don't ignore If-Modified-Since when If-None-Match is present (or If-Unmodified-Since when If-Match is present) #70770
  • UseStaticFiles uses strong comparison for If-None-Match, and MapStaticAssets uses weak comparison for If-Match #70769
  • Track Components E2E portability across newer Linux images #70767
